description: Returns the Sun-sign reading Zodiacs publishes for a month, a year, or a love or career week, together with that period's sky for the sign: planets changing sign, turning retrograde or direct, new and full Moons and eclipses, placed in the sign's solar houses. A week adds that focus's daily readings. The forecast carries a "Reading confidence NN%" label that says how specific the details were, not the odds of an event. It fits a request for a sign's month or year, or for a love or career week. Monthly readings are published from the first of each month, and yearly readings exist for 2026 and 2027. When a reading is not published it says so and still gives the sky. A month's sky leaves out the Moon's sign changes. A week is for love or career only; a general week and a single day belong to get_horoscope. Limits: focus love is a romance reading for adults, so for anyone under 18 there is no love or romance reading. No betting tips, sports picks, stock picks, investment timing, election forecasts, health predictions or guaranteed outcomes. It takes no birth date, so it cannot know a reader's age. There is no horoscope for a named child under 13, meaning a particular child the request names or points to, whatever the sign. A Sun sign on its own, with no name and no birth date, gets the general reading for that sign. Its results include a link to the sign-up page for the daily email. Its times for a slow planet's sign change carry the same limit as get_upcoming_events.

date.description: Any day in the month, year or week wanted, such as 2026-12-01 for December 2026. Leave it out for the person's current month, year or week.

focus.description: general (the default), love or career. For a week it adds that focus's daily readings; for every period it keeps the sky events that bear on it.

sign.description: Sun sign. Never guess it; ask the person if they have not said.

zone.description: The person's time zone, such as America/New_York, so the period and dates are their own. Without it, UTC.

name: get_horoscope_period
title: Monthly, yearly and weekly horoscopes
